omarchy.method: Byte-for-byte copy, no whitespace or proportion changes. ANSI 32 presentation from installed bin/omarchy-show-logo.

heartchy.method: UX-002 basis generated once by reviewed fixed upstream Bash/awk using Delta Corps Priest 1. UX-003 manually harmonizes the text with the unmodified installed Omarchy wordmark; only final text is distributed, no font or generator. Pink identity is #ff87af, contrast-adjusted shade in light previews.
heartchy.limitation: Heartchy is a manually tuned derivative, not an unmodified font output or an official Omarchy logo.

manual_adjustments.H: Both H glyphs use stock columns [59,71): three-cell stems, three-cell counter, half-block crossbar and tapered foot.
manual_adjustments.E: Redrawn from the stock C profile: same stem, upper/lower counter; shorter half-block middle arm.
manual_adjustments.A: Stock columns [27,37), including crossbar and taper, replaces the wider generated closed crossbar.
manual_adjustments.R: Stock columns [38,48), including its tenth-row descender and compact bowl.
manual_adjustments.T: New symmetrical nine-cell beam with half-block caps and a centered three-cell stem; replaces the generated diagonal overhang and ornamental foot. Stem tapers like stock H/A.
manual_adjustments.C: Stock columns [50,59), preserves upper/lower open counter and compact bowl.
manual_adjustments.Y: Stock columns [72,81), preserves counter/crossbar, lower bowl and tapered base.
manual_adjustments.spacing: Two-cell inter-glyph gap, ten-row canvas aligned with stock; no scaling, clipping or edits to Omarchy asset.
